done_when: The next review's brief lists every Ruling: line from the branch's commit messages and every dismissal with its reason, and tells the reviewer to raise a ruled or dismissed point again only with new evidence; a test runs forge close twice and sees both in the second brief

findings.body: The `--no-merges` flag omits every merge commit message. When a default-branch conflict is resolved manually, as directed by `src/forge/close.py:171-182`, the resulting merge commit can contain a `Ruling:` line, but that ruling will never appear in the next review brief. Include merge commit messages when collecting rulings.
findings.title: Include Ruling lines from merge commits

why: Reviewers reverse the coordinator's earlier rulings, because a ruling's reason never reaches the next review
